beschrijving_html:
Warning: this book may cause giggle fits!

What do snowmen call their kids? Chill-dren! What do you call a reindeer with no eyes? No eye deer!

Ho Ho Ha Ha! is packed with 300 clean, silly Christmas jokes, riddles and knock-knock jokes that kids love to read out loud and test on the whole family.

Inside you'll find:

  • 300 kid-friendly jokes in 12 festive chapters: Santa, reindeer, elves, snowmen, Christmas trees, presents, cookies and candy canes, winter animals, knock-knock jokes, snow days, riddles and Christmas dinner
  • Big, easy-to-read print with the answer right under every joke
  • Tricky riddles to stump the grown-ups
  • A page to write your very own Christmas joke

The perfect stocking stuffer

A screen-free gift for boys and girls ages 6 to 12 that keeps everyone laughing on Christmas morning, on long car rides and at the dinner table.

Scroll up and add some laughter to Christmas.
